column1: # IBKR TWS API message codes, with the grade ib_async assigns each one.
#   plus the blanket range 2100 <= code < 2200. Everything else is fatal: for a trade that is not
#   isDone(), ib_async sets orderStatus.status = Cancelled locally and emits cancelledEvent,
#   without sending anything to the venue.
# Codes absent from this file are absent from the IBKR published table (e.g. 10257, 10349, 2127, and
#   warningCodes members 492/10167). Absence is not evidence a code does not exist, and codes in
#   [2100,2200) are warning-grade by the blanket rule even when unlisted. See error-codes-and-verdicts.md.
